We have mass spec data: peaks at m/z 100.0524 (intensity 100) and isotopic pattern suggests maybe molecular ion at 100.0524. Proton NMR: Deltas 2.93 (dd, J=7.7,4.2 Hz, 3H), 4.43 (dd, J=8.0,4.8 Hz,1H), 5.04 (dd, J=16.7,1.4 Hz,2H), 6.05 (ddd, J=16.7,10.9,8.0 Hz,1H). That suggests maybe an ester? The simulated spectra for C=CC(=O)OCC (ethyl acrylate) gave similar pattern: H NMR: 1.17 t (3H), 4.14 q (2H), 6.02 dd (1H), 6.37 dd (1H), 6.85 dd (1H). Our experimental: 2.93 (dd, 3H) - that's a methyl at ~2.9, not 1.2. 4.43 (dd, 1H) maybe CH? 5.04 (dd, 2H) maybe CH2 attached to O? 6.05 (ddd, 1H) maybe vinyl. The simulated for ethyl acrylate has methyl at 1.17 (ethyl). Not matching.

Our experimental methyl at 2.93 suggests maybe acetyl group (CH3 attached to carbonyl). 4.43 dd 1H maybe CH attached to O? 5.04 dd 2H maybe CH2 attached to O? 6.05 ddd 1H vinyl. Could be methyl acrylate? Methyl acrylate SMILES: C=CC(=O)OC. Let's simulate?
